title: Global API Error Body
description: Closed error body returned by the API's catch-all error handler for failures no route handled itself (most commonly an unhandled 500). It is a different shape from error_envelope_schema.json: there is no `message` and the machine code is `code`, not `error_code`. `error` is a fixed phrase chosen by the server for the status (for a 5xx always "Internal server error"); it never carries exception text or any value the client sent. The body never carries a request id; the id travels only in the `X-Request-ID` response header. Operations whose route wraps its own failures keep declaring error_envelope_schema.json or their own bare body.

success.description: Discriminator. Always false for error responses.

error.x-content-note: Server-chosen fixed phrase for the status; not provably closed in the schema.
error.description: Fixed server-authored phrase for the status (for example "Internal server error"). Never an exception string or client value.

code.x-content-note: Server-chosen closed code; not enumerated here.
code.description: Stable upper-snake machine code for the status (for example "INTERNAL_ERROR", or "PROJECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED" for a 422 write-scope refusal).
